items.text: 《矩阵：零日危机》服务器已于北京时间2026年2月28日10:00（UTC+8）完成停服更新维护，感谢大家的持续支持！
1.修复了「修正行动」加点以后立刻退出再进入，数目显示不对的问题
2.修复了「外观」明日香・丹绮春序、零・浅楹春时的品质颜色错误的问题
祝各位英雄战斗愉快，我们矩阵世界见！
《矩阵：零日危机》运营团队
Dear Rogueteers,

Terminull Brigade will be down for server maintenance starting from Dec 18, 2025 at 15:00 (UTC+8). Server maintenance is projected to last for 4 hours. During this period, Rogueteers will not be able to access the game.
If the server maintenance is not concluded within this period, it will be extended. We ask for all Rogueteers' understanding.
\[Gameplay Updates]
Gameplay
● Increased the Advanced Locator drop rate in Corrective Action and in the final chapter of Exploration Mode.
● Increased the drop rates of all items in Protostar (Finale).
● Reduced the skill damage multiplier for certain elites in Protostar stages.
● Reduced the difficulty of enemy lineups in Corrective Action in Protostar stages.
Upgrade Systems
● Optimized Chaos, Collapse, Disintegration, Anomaly, and other attribute-related descriptions.
\[Store Updates]
● The new Immortal-tier skins Rei: Eternal Vow (Yuri) and Asuka: Devoted Pledge (Diana) can be obtained through the Terminull Pact Data Vault.
● New Crystal Core Packs, Pulse Core Packs, Refactor Core Packs, and Conversion Core Packs are now available in the Store.
\[Bug Fixes]
Equipment Systems
● Hailstorms triggered by the equipment Perk Trait Hoarfrost Verdict now properly deal damage.
● While using Yuri in combat, aiming down sights and then checking equipment names no longer causes drift.
● Cores now correctly display lowered attributes after a Data Refactoring failure.
● Entering the Core Upgrade menu during recruitment no longer triggers a bug.
● Expansion Data is now properly grayed out once equipment sub-attributes are maxed out. This was a purely display-related issue that did not actually consume Expansion Data.
● Switching from the Equipment to Refactor interface no longer causes the game to freeze.
Rogueteers
● Blade's Invulnerability now expires properly when she uses Heartfelt's Weapon Skill.
● Changes to Dark Hunt's weapon skin color now properly takes effect.
● Yuri's skill, Holo-Sight, now properly triggers damage numbers when attacking Conqueror Slimes.
● Yuri's Disable Weapon Skills trait no longer disables the enhanced shot of her skill Holo-Sight.
● While stealthed, Yuri can no longer bypass Jory's Invulnerability with multi-hit attacks.
● Magazine and attack speed effects now properly apply to Max’s weapon, One Shot to Flatten 'Em All.
Gameplay
● Item drop previews in Viral Frenzy now correctly display Expansion Cores rather than Pulse Cores.
Enemies
● Virus Core no longer freezes when entering Phase 2.
Other Issues
● Fixed damage loss in certain combat situations.
● Arbiters can now be rerolled with the default Z key.
● Fixed errors in the Battle History display in the Career interface.
● Fixed incorrect descriptions when claiming item rewards in the Life in the Terminull event.

releases.displayName: Season 2 Launch Patch Notes — Rebirth: Code Invasion

items.text: Dear Rogueteers,

The servers of Terminull Brigade will be temporarily shut down for maintenance on December 3rd, 2025, from 02:00 (EST) until 06:00 (EST), during which Rogueteers will not be able to access the game. If the server maintenance is not concluded within this period, it will be extended. We ask for all Rogueteers' understanding. Thank you all for your continued support!
After this maintenance, S1 "Stellar Rhythm" will end, and S2 "Rebirth: Code Invasion" will begin.

The Ever-verse will unlock the Combat Terminull's temporary Warehouse, where S1 Modules and Cores will be stored. You can take out Modules that you'd like to keep and deposit them in the Ever-verse's Terminull Warehouse, but cannot deposit them back in the temporary Warehouse. The temporary Warehouse will be closed at the end of S2.
To be reset: All seasonal gameplay progress and data will be reset.

Items that will carry over to the next season: Unlocked Rogueteers and Skins, Proficiency, Ability Modules, Achievements, Decoders, Pass Points, and Store Coins (Platinum Coin, Tycho Coin, Purified Data).
Items that will be transferred to the Ever-verse's temporary Warehouse: Modules and Cores.
Items that will be removed: Terminull Coins, Crystal Cores, Core Fragments, Expanse Beacons, Basic Locators, Advanced Locators, and Module Store Redemption Items (Faded Modules).
New Exploration Mode will be available. In this remade Main Story, follow Aion's guidance to uncover Terminull's secrets step by step.
The original Standard Mode will be changed to Classic Mode, which keeps the original gameplay, but equipment stats will not take effect in this mode.
Perk and Key of Potential selection will be removed from all modes except Classic Mode.
Corrective Action's objective will be adjusted to defeat enough enemies to earn progress. At 100% progress, Rogueteers will be able to challenge the boss.
Corrective Action's Chaos effects can be customized. Rogueteers will be able to spend Breakdown Points to select different Chaos effects for their builds.
The "Chromatic Treasure Cat" gameplay will be added to Corrective Action. Defeating Treasure Cats of different colors will drop different rewards.
Mystery Crates will be added to Corrective Action. Mystery Crates will have a chance to spawn during battle and will grant rewards when looted.
An Easter Egg stage, Wonderland, will be added to Corrective Action as an extra challenge. Successful completion will grant rewards.
The "Viral Nest" gameplay will be added to Corrective Action. Viral Nests will have a chance to spawn during battle. Destroying them all will grant rewards.
The "Mystery Trap" gameplay will be added to Corrective Action. Stepping into a trap will summon random monsters but will also grant a random buff.
A double boss challenge involving Blade and the Punisher will be added to Corrective Action.
Floors 51-70 will be added to Corrective Action, with significantly increased difficulty and rewards.
A new boss, Virus Core, will be added to Chains of Disorder.
Viral Frenzy Mode will return with new events and mechanics.
Endless Expanse Mode will be taken offline.
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45327692/914bc3b00fa1a91b46e71320ea7c91244f07666c.jpg"]
A new Rogueteer, Diana, will go live: A competitive and powerful bounty hunter who fights with a spear and assault rifle. She is a versatile all-rounder capable of both offense and defense.
A new Rogueteer, Yuri, will go live: A calm and decisive ace sniper powerful enough to tear through space.
Gloria's new weapon, Spirit Witch's Healing, will be available.
Colonel's new weapon, Adjudicator, will be available.
The Equipment system will be launched, unlocking 11 equippable slots.

The original Arbiter Perks and Keys of Potential will now serve as Equipment Traits. Rare or higher-quality equipment will be guaranteed to carry 1-2 Perk Traits, allowing Rogueteers to create different Perk builds with equipment.

The equipment category, Chip, will be available. Weapon Chips, Skill Chips, and Speed Chips will have Arbiter active Perks and corresponding enhancement Traits. Potential Chips will be guaranteed to carry Key of Potential Traits.

The equipment category, Armor, will be available, including Head, Torso, Waist, and Leg Armor. They will have Arbiter Passive Perk Trait and various mechanic Traits (formerly Module Traits from the Combat Terminull). Immortal Armor will have Rogueteer-exclusive Traits.
The equipment category, Ornament, will be available, including Rings, Bracelets, and Necklaces. They will have Arbiter Passive Perk Traits or Duo Perks Traits.
All Module Traits (including Rogueteer Traits) from the previous season's Combat Terminull will be available from equipment.
New attributes, Special Attack and Special Resistance, will be added, which will increase Special Attack bonuses and resistance to Special Damage.

A new Arbiter, Wasteland, will be available: As the dominant Arbiter of the Wasteland, it specializes in chained bursts and stacking damage amplification. Acquire its Perk Traits from Equipment Traits.
The Combat Terminull and Season Talents will be temporarily taken offline.
Enemy Traits that benefit Rogueteers will be added. After defeating certain enemies, Rogueteers will be able to pick up dropped buffs such as AoE Time Stop, AoE Black Hole, and Elemental Orbs.
The AI and skill combinations for Cyber Ranged Elites, Geomancer Elites, and Reaper Elites will be optimized and upgraded. Combat scenarios featuring a mix of elites will be added.
Standard enemy AI will be optimized to improve the overall in-match combat experience.
Materials from disassembled equipment will be standardized to Faded Equipment Shards.
The Module Store will be changed to the Equipment Store, with Intensity IV or above Arbiter Chip Equipment added.
Oblivion's Pact: Blade's weapon damage cannot CRIT. All weapon CRIT damage beyond 100% is instead converted into Weapon Power at 3× efficiency, up to a maximum of 3200%.

Doom's Surge: After Blade maxes out the Arbiter of Energy's Power Surge stacks, weapon damage charges up Supernova Burst, triggered at most once every 0.5s. Each Power Surge stack increases Supernova Burst damage by 15%.
Barrage Suppression: Reduce Aurora's rate of fire by 0.5× but increase her projectile count by 2.
Thunder Meister: While Aurora's Minor is active, increase all Arbiter of Thunder damage by 300%.
Annihilation Protocol: After Colonel activates a skill, increase weapon CRIT damage by 1.5×. This effect can stack if triggered by different skills.
Overload Focus: Colonel's skills builds Power Surge strikes twice as fast. Increase Power Surge strike damage by 300%.
Rocket Blastwave: When Max's rockets deal damage, trigger an additional ranged effect that deals weapon damage, at most once every 0.1s.
Explosive Symphony: Each time Max inflicts Repulsion damage from the Arbiter of Music, increase Repulsion damage by 1%, up to 300 stacks.
Source Convergence: Increase Heynckes' weapon damage bonus by 50% of his skill damage bonus, 25% of his Primary damage bonus, 50% of his Minor damage bonus, and 15% of his Ultimate damage bonus.
Overlimit Liberation: After Heynckes lands a CRIT, increase weapon CRIT damage by 1.3× and skill CRIT damage by 1.3× for 5s, up to 5 stacks.
Flash of Insight: When Gloria lands a weapon CRIT, all Turrets' subsequent attack additionally deal 100% of this instance of damage as true damage.
Critical Chain: When Gloria's skills CRIT, Turrets attack 1 additional time, triggered at most once every 2s.
Sonic Frenzy: At or above 80 Revelry, Rebela's triggered Sound Waves have a 5% chance to be treated as weapon damage.
Twin Rhythm: At or above 50 Revelry, double Rebela's Arbiter of Music damage.

Holo-Engraving: If Yuri has aimed down sights at an enemy for over 2s, immediately triggers one upgraded Holo-Sight attack, at most once every 5s. Closing the scope cancels the upgraded attack but does not refund its cooldown.
Afterimage Sniping: While Yuri's Minor is active, create 1 clone every second. The clone casts Primary alongside Yuri, then disappears thereafter.
Ready to Strike: Each stack of Endurance increases Diana's final damage by 15%.
Endless Hunt: Increase Diana's Primary damage by 3×. Potential Chip: Hunting Penetration can strike the same enemy repeatedly, up to 10 times.
In order to enhance your gaming experience, we have completed a server update on October 20, 20:00 (UTC+8). Thank you for your continued support!
\[Updated Contents]
Increased all drop rates until the end of the current season.
● Increased the Immortal Module drop rate in Chains of Disorder by 100%, and the First-Tune and Final-Tune Crystal Core drop rate by 200%.
● Increased the Reshape Crystal Core, Exchange Crystal Core, Reset Crystal Core, and Refactor Data drop rate by 100%, and the Space Bunny, Support Ears, and Sonata drop rate by 100%.
\[Fixed Issues]
● Combat Terminull
1. Fixed a display issue in the Combat Terminull in which the same type of Module could be added beyond the stated capacity (although Modules beyond the capacity would not actually take effect).
2. Fixed a display issue in which certain Modules incorrectly showed up as Legendary-tier when dropped.
● Gameplay Modes
1. Fixed an issue with Endless Expanse in which finishing a stage in too short a period of time may result in the inability to claim first-clear rewards.
2. Removed the default matchmaking option and the solo difficulty prompt upon starting a battle.
● Others
Fixed an issue where the Season Pass was incorrectly displayed as S0 in rare cases.
Wishing all Rogueteers successful battles ahead! See you in the world of Terminull!
Terminull Brigade Development Team

Terminull Brigade will be down for server maintenance starting from Oct 11 at 15:00 (UTC +8). Server maintenance is projected to last for 4 hours. During this period, Rogueteers will not be able to access the game.
If the server maintenance is not concluded within this period, it will be extended. We ask for all Rogueteers' understanding.
\[Content Updates]
Season-exclusive accessory drops will be added to Corrective Action:
The Space Bunny accessory drops from Corrective Action Floor 11 and above.
The Support Ears accessory drops from Corrective Action Floor 31 and above.
The Sonata accessory drops from Corrective Action Floor 41 and above.
The acquisition methods for Blade and Max have been adjusted. They may now be obtained from side missions rather than clearing Introduction to Ringed City for the first time.
Immortal-tier Bulwark module drops have been adjusted. They will no longer be available from Chains of Disorder and instead have a chance to drop from Corrective Action Floor 41 and above.
A new Resplendent skin, Neon Rhythm Field, is now available for Gloria. It may be obtained from Data Vault - Natural Rhythm.
\[Bug Fixes]
Rogueteers
Fixed a potential conflict between Max's Key of Potential, Blood Boiling, and other stats and attributes that regenerate Health.
Fixed a bug in which Gloria had a chance of being unable to cast her skills after repeatedly activating her Primary multiple times.
Combat Terminull
Fixed combat irregularities resulting from Aurora's equipment's exclusive Immortal trait, Favored by Fortune.
Fixed a bug in which Immortal and Legendary Modules' traits related to Arbiters' Blessings were activating in a mutually exclusive manner.
Fixed Terminull Preset data errors resulting from reconnecting after a DC.
Stages and Gameplay
Fixed impact errors in some Protostar maps.
Fixed incorrect Advanced Locator drops on some Corrective Action floors.
Fixed an issue in which the game freezes after Jory dies during his first phase in Chains of Disorder.
Ability Module
Fixed a Season Talent issue in which Max's Key of Potential could not be leveled up.
Fixed Primary skill charge irregularities associated with the Data Surge node in Ability Module.
Others
Fixed an issue in which Blade's weapon skin, Dark Hunt, did not take effect in combat.
Fixed an issue in which changing the color of Immortal skins caused settlement animations to not trigger.
Fixed an incorrect link associated with Aion's Gifts.
Fixed abnormal behavior from applying to join someone else's recruitment roster.
The Terminull Brigade Operations Team will continue improving on all Rogueteers' gaming experience and feedback. Please enjoy the game. See you in the world of Terminull!

releases.displayName: Season 1 Launch Patch Notes — Stellar Rhythm

items.text: Dear Rogueteers,

Thank you for charging through S0: Ground Zero with us. Your feedback, clutch saves, and endless theory-crafting set the stage for our first full Season. The beat now drops with S1: Stellar Rhythm—a fresh world, a new Rogueteer, deeper systems, and a suite of quality-of-life upgrades to keep your runs smooth and your builds singing.
Below are the maintenance times and everything landing with the Season launch.

notes.title: Season 1 begins after scheduled maintenance (~4 hours)

items.text: PDT (UTC−7): Tue, Sep 23, 7:00–11:00 PM
EDT (UTC−4): Tue, Sep 23, 10:00 PM – Wed, Sep 24, 2:00 AM
If extra time is needed, server reopening will be postponed. Thanks for your patience while we tune the servers for a smoother Season.
S0 ends → S1: Stellar Rhythm begins
New World: Protostar + Arbiter of Stars (mark + chain damage)
New Mode: Endless Delve (pre-pick Arbiter Perks & Keys; Core drops)
Systems: Season Talents, Bulwark/Defense Modules, refreshed trait pools
QoL: Loadout Presets, Keyword Search, smarter sorting, lock/discard at settlement
Events: Login rewards (Legendary skin), weekly missions, weekend training, limited-time draws
Skins: Immortal Trendsetter Maestro (Heat Wave) for Max; new Resplendents for Blade, Rebela, Heynckes
Season Switch: After maintenance, S0: Ground Zero concludes and S1: Stellar Rhythm kicks off.
Prior-season Combat Terminull move to the Ever-verse (equip-only; not craftable).
Standard Mode remains playable in the Ever-verse (all difficulties, no drops).
Progress Reset: Progress across all game modes and related data resets for S1.
Carries Into S1: Unlocked Rogueteers & Skins, Proficiency, Ability Modules, Achievements, Decoders, and store currencies (Platinum Coins, Tycho Coins, Purified Data).
Transferred to Ever-verse: Modules, Cores.
Removed at Season Start: Terminull Coins, Crystal Cores, Core Fragments, Suppression Code, Basic/Advanced Locators, Module Store Redemption Items (Faded/Charged/Overloaded Modules).
Fresh enemy traits and a new seasonal combat flavor.
Arbiter of Stars replaces Arbiter of Games in Protostar—marks targets and chains damage.
Choose Arbiter Perks & Keys before combat.
Unlock: Clear Floor 10 of Corrective Action.
Rewards: Drops Cores.
Adds Protostar content and new Duo Bosses on higher floors.
Breakdown Point reworked into buffs (not debuffs).
New Chaotic effects added.
New music-themed Protostar boss fight joins the rotation.
Seasonal mode Viral Frenzy has been removed.
New Rogueteer: Rebela — a music-driven adventurer wielding a harmonic battle-axe; confident at close and mid-range.
Heynckes – Frostfire Waltz: Obtain via Pass or Shop.
Max – One Shot to Flatten ’Em All: Earnable from the S1 launch event.
New Season Talent system amps up Keys of Potential and Talent attributes.
Unlock: Clear Difficulty 5 of Standard Mode.
Bulwark Module: Unique single-slot Module that buffs neighboring Modules.
Defense Module: New defensive option to mitigate damage.
Legendary Modules: +20 new Traits.
Immortal Modules: +14 Rogueteer-exclusive Traits, +9 Arbiter-related Traits.
Removed: S0’s Rogueteer-exclusive & Arbiter-related Traits.
All Module redemption materials consolidated to Faded Modules; new redemptions unlock with Corrective Action progress.
Excess Code can be exchanged for Terminull Coins.
Preset System: Save three Terminull presets; swap and activate anytime.
Keyword Search: Find Modules by name/ID, filter by traits & shapes.
Smarter Sorting: Prioritizes strong/limit-breaking attributes (yellow sub-attributes).
Faster Management: Lock or discard Modules directly from the settlement screen.
S1 Launch: Log in across multiple days to claim Colonel’s Legendary Skin – Electro Burnbeat and more.
Tycho Treasure: Complete weekly missions to earn Modules.
Weekly Training (Thu–Sun): Grab Advanced Locators, First-Tune Cores, Final-Tune Cores, and more.
Stellar Rhythm – Value Gift: Spend 10+ Purified Data to unlock new Accessories; logins grant Platinum Coins and extra rewards tied to spending.
Stellar Rhythm Supply: Own designated Skins or unlock the S1 Pass to claim limited-time goodies.
Verdict of the Crimson Sky: Spend Purified Data for a chance at Heynckes’ Resplendent Skin – Verdict of the Crimson Sky (first draw is free).
More events incoming—follow our official channels for updates.
Immortal: Trendsetter Maestro (Heat Wave) — Max
Max returns from a Journey to the West-inspired odyssey, rainbow-wreathed with a radiant cloud underfoot.
Mesmeric Heist (Blade)
Doomsday Sound Wave (Rebela)
Verdict of the Crimson Sky (Heynckes)
Thanks for tuning in, syncing up, and shredding with us this Season. Your runs, feedback, and bug reports keep the Nullverse humming—please keep them coming.
See you out there, Rogueteers.
— Terminull Brigade Team
Dear Rogueteers,
We will be performing server maintenance on Wednesday, Aug 27, at 00:00 (PDT).
The downtime is expected to last for approximately 1 hour as we implement performance optimizations to ensure smoother gameplay.
During this period, the game will be unavailable. Should the maintenance require additional time, server reopening will be postponed accordingly.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience as we continue working to improve your experience in the Nullverse.
See you back on the battlefield soon!
— The Terminull Brigade Team

We will be conducting scheduled server maintenance on Aug 13, 00:00 (PDT) / Aug 13, 07:00 (UTC). The maintenance is expected to last for 2 hours, during which time access to Terminull Brigade will be temporarily unavailable. As a token of appreciation for your patience, all Rogueteers will receive 300 Tycho Coins in the mail following the maintenance.
\[Content Updates]
Boss HP Bars: HP bars for bosses across various difficulty levels have been adjusted to provide a more accurate representation of their remaining health.
Module Warehouse Capacity Detection: A new feature has been added to notify Rogueteers when their Warehouse is nearing capacity, allowing you to clear out space quickly and avoid unnecessary losses.
Immortal-Tier Module Drop Rate: The drop rate for Immortal-tier Modules has been increased.
Standard Mode Optimization: Perfect Clear times can now be checked at higher difficulty levels, and various rules for Standard Mode have been fine-tuned.
Legendary Skins: Descriptions for Legendary Rogueteer skins have been optimized for clarity.
\[Bug Fixes]
In-Game Contents
Rogueteers
Gloria’s Ultimate special effects have been optimized to prevent stuttering.
Gloria's turrets will now always target the boss Wuxiang after it burrows underground.
Gloria’s Rescuebots will expire correctly after use.
Drops from Max’s Minor will no longer affect the team’s movement speed.
Fixed unintended interactions when downed Rogueteers revive using Respawn Coins.
Enemies
Malcolm, the boss, will no longer lose invulnerability while transforming.
Wuxiang’s laser attack display now lasts as long as the attack itself.
Fixed persistent laser attack sound effects for Wuxiang.
Fixed issues with certain enemies' transformation stages.
Arbiters
The Arbiter of Music’s Musical Notes can no longer penetrate obstacles.
The Arbiter of Fortune’s Lucky Weapon now applies the correct bonus.
The Fog of Desire produced by the Arbiter of Desire now deals damage to GT-6300.
Display effects for both the Arbiter of Music and Arbiter of Desire will now expire properly.
The Arbiter of Energy’s Power Up display effects now expire correctly.
Ability Module
Fixed errors in certain Ability Module descriptions.
Resolved Overload Shot-related issues in the Ability Module.
Combat Terminull
Data now displays correctly when swapping installed Cores.
Weapon Charge and Skill Charge traits now apply properly between maps.
Corrective Action
Primary Skill refresh spots now generate recovery items.
Auto-Save in Corrective Action no longer overwrites filled save slots.
Fixed stuttering caused by certain special effects.
Other Game Contents
Arbiter Anecdotes missions now track progress correctly across all game modes.
Fixed issues in the script for the main story mission Wasteland Virus Cleanup (Difficulty 7).
Other Fixes
Various translation issues have been resolved.
Sound effects in cutscenes now play at normal volume.
Fixed several game-crashing bugs.
Voice chat display errors caused by specific actions have been fixed.
Fixed overlapping Skins interface with other game interfaces.
Seasonal avatars now display properly.
Default frame rate cap settings now apply as intended.
The Terminull Brigade Team remains committed to improving your gaming experience. We hope you enjoy the latest updates, and we look forward to seeing you in the Nullverse!
Dear Rogueteers,

It’s been just two days since launch, and we’ve been closely listening to your feedback. We know the limited access to Rogueteers early on wasn’t the best experience, and we sincerely apologize. This is not the Nullverse we want to build with you.
We agree that the way some Rogueteers were unlocked didn’t make the best first impression. Based on your input, we’re making some immediate changes to improve that experience.
Maintenance Details

Terminull Brigade will undergo server maintenance on (PDT) Aug-01 12PM / (UTC) Aug-01 7PM, lasting around 1 hour (subject to change). During this time, the game will be unavailable. After the maintenance, you will receive 300 Tycho Coins as a reward via in-game mail!
\[Main Update]
Max, previously available through the Shop or Tycho Coins, will now be unlocked for free after completing First Entry to Ringed City.
Blade, previously unlocked by clearing difficulty 3, will now be available for free after completing First Entry to Ringed City.
Fixed the issue where the red dot on the mail icon wouldn’t disappear.
Fixed crashes related to certain graphics cards.
Fixed the loud BOSS intro CG sound effect.
What’s Next?
After maintenance, all players who logged in before the update will receive Max and Blade via in-game mail. If you purchased Max or unlocked Blade, here’s your compensation plan:
\[Compensation Plan]
Max Supreme Pack Purchasers: You’ll get a refund of 120% of the original price of Max (980 Platinum Coins) in Purified Data (1176 Purified Data).
Tycho Coin Exchangers for Max: Full refund of 980 Tycho Coins.
Blade Unlockers (difficulty 3): Compensation includes Faded Module x480, Charged Module x230, and Overloaded Module x230.
\[Compensation Timing]
If you purchased Max, exchanged Tycho Coins, or unlocked Blade before (PDT) Aug-01 5AM / (UTC) Aug-01 12PM, you’ll receive your compensation by (PDT) Aug-02 8:59AM / (UTC) Aug-02 3:59PM.
If you made those purchases or unlocks between (PDT) Aug-01 5AM and the start of maintenance, compensation will be sent by (PDT) Aug-03 8:59AM / (UTC) Aug-03 3:59PM.

If you miss out on compensation, please contact in-game customer support with your ID, Rogueteer name, and unlock time. To find your ID, click your avatar in the \[Game Lobby], go to \, and copy your \.
\[Looking Ahead]
The S0 season of Terminull Brigade has officially begun! We’re excited to continue improving and polishing the game with your valuable feedback. Thanks for sticking with us—we’re in this together!
See you in the Nullverse, Rogueteers!
Terminull Brigade Team
Hey Rogueteers! 🎯
With the Beta Test approaching, we have prepared detailed patch notes to inform you about the new and updated content you can expect to experience during this playtest.
Click Here to Read the detailed Beta Notes!
Have fun and kick ass!
